description: This file contains utility functions for geospatial data processing, including encoding and decoding geohashes, and parsing geodetic point strings using geopy.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Class from geopy used to parse geodetic point strings.

methods.name: geohash_decode
methods.description: Decodes a geohash column into latitude and longitude columns.

methods.name: geohash_encode
methods.description: Encodes latitude and longitude columns into a geohash column.

methods.name: geodetic_parse
methods.description: Parses a geodetic point string into latitude, longitude, and optionally altitude columns.
